## ChipGroup.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `options` :: The chips to choose from.
- `value` :: The chosen value, or an array of values when `multiple` is set. Two-way bindable.
- `onValueChange` :: Called whenever the person changes the selection.
- `multiple` :: Toggles any number of chips instead of picking one.
- `size` :: The chip height. Text follows this unless `textSize` is set.
- `textSize` :: The text scale, independent of the chip height. Follows `size` when omitted.
- `label` :: Accessible name of the group.
- `disabled` :: Blocks pointer and keyboard input.
- `name` :: The field name; hidden input(s) submit the value with a form.
- `shape` :: The corner shape of every chip. @default 'round'
- `childTextSize` :: The scale of the count beside a chip label. @default 'text-xs'
- `childTextColor` :: The ink of the count beside a chip label. @default 'text-muted'
- `gap` :: The space between chips. @default 'gap-sm'

## options.ts

### `interface ChipOption`

One chip in a ChipGroup. `T` is the type of the value it stands for.

- `value` :: The value written to `value` when the chip is chosen.
- `label` :: The visible label.
- `icon` :: An icon drawn before the label.
- `count` :: A count drawn after the label, for filter chips that summarise a set.
- `disabled` :: Shown but not choosable.

### `function valueKey`

A string for a value — the form value of a hidden input, and a stable DOM key.
